Conceptual workflow

Selected engineering work

In development · Two projects

Water infrastructure SCADA development

Database and interface development across two ongoing water-sector projects, working with operational, consumption, and non-revenue water (NRW) data.

  • Ignition
  • Microsoft SQL Server
  • Application scripting
Explore my contribution+
Project
SCADA and operational-data applications for water infrastructure in Jordan. This overview brings together my responsibilities across two ongoing projects.
My contribution
Database structure design, Ignition database integration, frontend interface development, and backend application scripting.
Engineering scope
Working with large volumes of water-sector operational data, including consumption and non-revenue water (NRW) information.
Technologies
Ignition and Microsoft SQL Server, with stored procedures, indexes, queries, and application scripts.
Challenge
Keeping data access efficient and application logic maintainable as the volume of operational data grows.
Implementation
Organizing database structures, using stored procedures to handle database-side logic, and applying indexing and query optimization to support the SCADA application.
Supported result
Both projects are in development. Database and interface work is ongoing; final delivery and measured outcomes are not yet available.

04 / A little about me

Engineering meets
visual thinking.

Current role

SCADA & IoT Engineer

Spacia Systems

SCADA applications, databases, and IoT.

My core work brings together SCADA, databases, and IoT. I design database structures, develop application scripts, and connect Ignition interfaces to the data behind them.

Alongside this work, I use Blender to create equipment models and bring them into SCADA through rendered animation frames. SVG-based 2.5D graphics offer another way to make industrial interfaces easier to understand.
